clips.title: The story
paras: Feero Ironhand carries provisions and messages north from Maestra's Post toward Auberdine, with Alliance adventurers guarding the way. Trouble around the Tower of Althalaxx and hostile infiltrators make the road unsafe.

Maestra's Post lies on Ashenvale's western frontier, between the forest and Darkshore. After investigations into sinister activity around the Tower of Althalaxx, Delgren the Purifier sends supplies and intelligence to Sentinel Starbreeze in Auberdine. The outpost relies on armed escorts instead of solitary couriers, so Feero Ironhand travels with guards along the forest road.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Delgren has asked me to deliver messages and supplies to Sentinel Starbreeze in Auberdine, but I am loathe to leave on my own. Dangerous foes operate in the forest, and I do not wish to risk letting these supplies and information fall into the wrong hands.
If you and others could act as my guards, I could leave now. With your protection, I have no doubt that we can see these goods safely to Auberdine.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Sentinels have a great need for supplies to reinforce themselves in Darkshore.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done well today, adventurer. The items we sent to aid Auberdine will be of immediate use in dealing with the dark threats that infest the forest.
Take these with my heartfelt thanks.
